collection_rules: Resolve channel IDs through permitted access before polling
Record collected_at and source data period separately
Store missing metrics as missing, never zero
Do not assume public access grants caption-download or media-reuse permission
Use authorized exports or permitted/licensed access for TikTok; do not assume Research API eligibility
Store private analytics in controlled storage, not this public repository
Content references are inspected for mechanisms; studio prestige is not audience evidence
Daily collection does not require a daily trend or recommendation; record no material change
Separate curated evergreen references from current social signals
Any planned scrape must use a permitted route and respect source access limits
primary_unit: Specific content and audience-culture signals; company identity is context only
company_watchlist_usage: Separate business intelligence only; F09 monitors content, not company ranking

accepted_inputs: Episode or scene links with timestamps
User-provided clips or files with access basis
Creative notes explaining what to learn
